title: IELTS on Computer / Paper

display.layout: current-delivery update banner + computer-vs-online comparison + practical requirements

highlights.heading: 2026 IELTS delivery change
highlights.text: IELTS announced that standard paper-based delivery would be phased out from mid-2026; exact dates differ by market, with Writing on Paper offered in selected places.
highlights.note: Externally verified current update (2026-03-05). Supersedes historical universal paper-test assumptions in CSV archive.

highlights.heading: Check local availability
highlights.text: Verify current local test-delivery options with the official booking provider.

highlights.heading: Academic online option
highlights.text: IELTS Online is an Academic test taken remotely where the service is available and accepted by the receiving institution.

highlights.heading: Remote Speaking
highlights.text: IELTS Online Speaking uses a live video call with an examiner.

highlights.heading: Equipment
highlights.text: Online testing requires a compatible computer, camera and microphone, alongside other requirements.

highlights.heading: Acceptance
highlights.text: Check with the receiving institution whether it accepts IELTS Online before booking.
